title: Bird Year
description:
Be a bird, feed your hungry hatchlings, and avoid the dangers of the forest all year long!

• Catch butterflies, worms, ladybugs, (and wasps, if you're a bluejay)

• Avoid hazards like falcons, eagles, flying squirrels, wasps, and cats​

• ​Eat berries to get a speed boost -- but watch out for snakes!

• ​Use abilities unique to each bird, like getting sap from trees as a woodpecker

• ​Unlock bonus content through gameplay, like the beach level!

• Each season features one of Vivaldi's 'The Four Seasons'​​ concerti
description_short: Bird Year is a gentle, family-friendly arcade game where you're a bird. Feed your hungry babies and avoid the dangers of the forest all year long. Catch bugs, eat berries and dodge predators while using your chosen bird's unique abilities. Unlock bonus content including more birds and a bonus level!
